import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
tr=pd.read_csv('train.csv'); te=pd.read_csv('test.csv')
cols=[c for c in tr.columns if c!='outcome']
zero_cols=['glucose','blood_pressure','skin_thickness','insulin','bmi']
def prep(d):
    d=d[cols].copy()
    for c in zero_cols: d[c]=d[c].replace(0,np.nan)
    return d
m=make_pipeline(SimpleImputer(strategy='median'),RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=500,random_state=42))
m.fit(prep(tr),tr.outcome)
print('test acc',accuracy_score(te.outcome,m.predict(prep(te))))
print('train acc',accuracy_score(tr.outcome,m.predict(prep(tr))))
"

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
tr=pd.read_csv('train.csv'); h=pd.read_csv('holdout_features.csv')
cols=[c for c in tr.columns if c!='outcome']
zero_cols=['glucose','blood_pressure','skin_thickness','insulin','bmi']
def prep(d):
    d=d[cols].copy()
    for c in zero_cols: d[c]=d[c].replace(0,np.nan)
    return d
m=make_pipeline(SimpleImputer(strategy='median'),RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=500,random_state=42))
m.fit(prep(tr),tr.outcome)
p=m.predict(prep(h[cols]))
pd.DataFrame({'prediction':p.astype(int)}).to_csv('predictions.csv',index=False)
print(len(p), np.bincount(p))

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
tr=pd.read_csv('train.csv')
cols=[c for c in tr.columns if c!='outcome']
zero_cols=['glucose','blood_pressure','skin_thickness','insulin','bmi']
X=tr[cols].copy()
for c in zero_cols: X[c]=X[c].replace(0,np.nan)
rf=RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=500,random_state=42).fit(SimpleImputer(strategy='median').fit_transform(X),tr.outcome)
imp=pd.Series(rf.feature_importances_,index=cols).sort_values()
ax=imp.plot.barh(title='Random forest feature importance (train)'); plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('live/feature_importance.png',dpi=100)
print(imp.round(3).to_dict())
